relation: Both listed neighbors (Tiger III power station / gogpt_plant_id 100000408825, and Vlora Floating Thermal Power Plant / gogpt_plant_id 100000408826) are the same asset class: KESH's leased 'Tiger 1' and 'Tiger 3' floating thermal power ships (110 MW combined), operated by Renco and 100%-owned by Excelerate Energy LP. Per Balkan Green Energy News, these are HEAVY FUEL OIL-fired internal-combustion power barges leased to Albania's utility KESH since 2022 -- not gas-fired, and not part of the Port of Vlora FSRU 2 project (different owner chain: Excelerate/Renco vs. the terminal's current owner Aktor LNG USA). These are also the 'unfunctional oil-fired power plant' the new Aktor/Atlantic SEE LNG Trade MOU proposes to convert to gas in the future -- a proposed future PowerPlantsSupplied relationship, not a present one, and not captive to the terminal either way. Independent source: https://balkangreenenergynews.com/us-italian-consortium-to-lease-oil-fired-power-plant-to-albania/
